Te#1113141 ExecutionVersion ZONINGLOTANDDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT is made as of this day of August, 2012 (this “Agreement"), by and among ROSE NEDERLANDER ASSOCIATES, INC., .a Delaware corporation, and J. NED, INC., a California corporation, each having an address at 1450 Broadway, 6"h Floor, New York, New York 10018 (collectively, “Transferor") and  PALMETTO HOSPITALITY OF MANHATTAN II, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address c/o OTO Development, LLC, 340 East Main Street, Suite 300, Spartanburg, South Carolina 29302 ("Transferee"). RECITALS: Transferor is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City,State and County of New York designated as Lot 38 in Block 1012 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, New York County (the “Tax Map") and known by the street address of 208 West 41 Street,NewYork,NewYork,which land is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (the “Transferor's Land"), together with the building and improvements thereon (the “Transferor's Improvements"); the Transferor's Land and Transferor's Improvements herein being referred to collectively as"Transferor'sPremises" Transferee is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City,State and County of New York designated as Lot 42 in Block 1012 on the Tax Map and known by the street address of 220-226West 41" Street, New York, New York, which land is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (the "Transferee's Land"), together with the improvements thereon (said existing with any future replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Transferee or Transferee's successors or assigns, and including without limitation, Transferee's New Building (as hereinafter defined); the Transferee's Land, Transferee's Existing Building and Transferee's New Building herein being referred to collectively as “Transferee's Premises". Transferee intends to demolish Transferee's Existing Building and construct a new building and improvements on Transferee's Land or renovate and/or expand Transferee's Existing Building (said new or expandedbuilding and improvements, together with any related improvements, additions, renovations, alterations, restorations, repairs and reconstructions thereto whether made by Transferee or Transferee's successors or assigns, herein being referred to collectively as "Transferee's New Building") with a bulk (as hereinafter defined) in excess of the bulk presently permitted to be constructed on Transferee's Premises under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined). The certification by Helpern Architects dated June 8, 2012 (attached hereto as Schedule 1) certifies that the Transferor's Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are 37,672 zoning square feet.
